end.parentNote: Lak practised reading letters as placeholders for numbers and writing expressions from short situations. They explained the plus and minus signs using the example of items added and taken away. Lak first asked what “X” meant, and this was clarified later by identifying it as a number placeholder (correctAfterLastSeen: true). At home, ask Lak to turn two everyday examples into expressions, such as “n pencils at ₹5 each, then 3 fewer.”
